info.title: KanPad backend-rs
info.description: KanPad API — board, column and card service (Axum + sqlx + MySQL).

post.description:
* The email is normalized (`trim` + lowercase) BEFORE validation.
* Validation is non-empty + 72-byte cap only (never strength): legacy
  weak-but-wellformed passwords reach auth (200 on match, 401 on
  mismatch), never 400.
* Unknown email runs [`dummy_verify`] (same Argon2 work as a real check)
  then 401s with the identical problem shape — no enumeration oracle.
* Verify order: Argon2 → on miss legacy bcrypt (cost-10 `$2a$`/`$2b$`,
  password truncated to 72 bytes) → on bcrypt success rehash to Argon2id
  + update the row in the same request. Never mints bcrypt.
* `session.cycle_id()` on every login (fixation defense). Session keys
  are `user_id`/`email`/`role`, matching the `AuthSession` contract.

`flush()` destroys the store row AND clears the in-memory id so the
middleware emits a cookie-removal (`Max-Age=0`); a bare `delete()` would
leave data behind and the session would be re-saved. Anonymous logout
still 204s (never 4xx on the destroy path). Deliberately unthrottled
(T30 scopes governor to login/register only — logging out must never
429).

get.description:
The ONLY auth read that re-looks-up the user row (plus admin routes):
deleted → 401; role drift (demoted/promoted since login) → 403 after
rotating the session id (privilege-change fixation hygiene). Returns the
fresh row values, never the stale session payload.

post.description:
* `REGISTRATION_ENABLED=false` → `403` (checked before validation, like
  Nest — role-denied, never 404).
* The email is normalized (`trim` + lowercase) BEFORE validation, so
  padded mixed-case input registers instead of 400ing.
* Bad email / weak / overlong password → `400` problem+json `errors[]`.
* Dup email → `409` (pre-check plus the `1062` race, which the shared
  `Db` arm maps to `409`).
* The Argon2id hash runs BEFORE `tx.begin()`; the tx holds only `INSERT
  user` + the single multi-row `INSERT labels` (no network `.await`
  while it is open).
* `session.cycle_id()` establishes a fresh authenticated session
  (fixation defense — register logs the user in, like Nest). Session keys
  are `user_id`/`email`/`role`, matching the T11 `AuthSession` contract.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/boards?project_id&archived&sort&order&page&limit → 200
Page<Board>` (flat items — no nested `columns[]`). Archived boards are
hidden unless `archived=true`; `project_id` scopes to that project (a
foreign or missing id matches zero rows — empty page, never a 403/404
oracle). There is deliberately NO `GET /boards/archived` duplicate:
`archived` in that position fails the `:id` int-parse → 400
`invalid-path`, never a 200 list.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description:
Project filter (`>= 1`); garbage (`?project_id=abc`) never reaches
garde — axum rejects it as 400 `invalid-query` first. A foreign or
missing id matches zero rows (empty page, never a 403/404 oracle).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/boards{name,background_color?,project_id?} → 201 {data} +
Location`. The board + 3 default columns (`To Do/In Progress/Done` 0/1/2)
are created in ONE tx; a foreign/missing `project_id` rolls back to 404
(no oracle, never 403). Blank/overlong names and bad hex colors → 400
`errors[]` via the DTO; `project_id` type garbage never reaches garde —
serde rejects it as 400 `invalid-json` first.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/boards/{boardId}/columns → 200 {data[]}` (nested unpaginated,
`position ASC`, embeds card summaries — never `description` TEXT).
Foreign/missing board id → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400
`invalid-path` via `ValidPath`.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/boards/{boardId}/columns{name?} → 201 {data} + Location`.
The position is `MAX(position)+1` taken under `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` in
the create tx; an absent name defaults to `New Column` (a present blank
still 400s via the DTO). Foreign/missing board id rolls back to 404 (no
oracle, never 403).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/boards/{id} → 200 {data:{…board,columns[]}}` (nested
unpaginated, `position ASC`, no cards). Foreign/missing id → 404 (no
oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path` via `ValidPath`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/boards/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body). Deleting an
ACTIVE board is a wrong-state operation → 409 `conflict` problem+json
(never 403 — the board IS owned, its state forbids the op); only archived
boards delete (archive first via `PATCH {is_archived:true}`). Columns,
cards, and notes cascade via `ON DELETE CASCADE` FKs. Foreign/missing id
→ 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/boards/{id} → 200 {data:{…board,columns[]}}` (every field
optional; present values validate like create). The board is pre-read for
ownership (foreign/missing id → 404, never 403 — affected-rows is NOT the
oracle since an idempotent no-change write reports zero), a `project_id`
relink is ownership-checked the same way (foreign → 404, also never 403),
then the patch applies in ONE tx and the response re-reads the stored
rows (never echoes). Archive/restore are plain `is_archived` flips —
idempotent by construction. Empty `{}` is a no-op 200.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/cards{title,column_id,position?,description?,due_date?} →
201 {data} + Location`. An explicit `position` clamps to `[0, max + 1]`
then opens a gap with a single range shift (never a verbatim duplicate
write); the default appends `MAX(position) + 1` taken under `SELECT ...
FOR UPDATE` in the create tx. A foreign/missing `column_id` rolls back to
404 (no oracle, never 403).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/cards/{cardId}/checklists → 200 {data[]}` (small-N,
unpaginated — added route per `21 §checklists`; `id ASC`, items embedded
`position ASC`). Foreign/missing card → 404 (no oracle, never 403).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/cards/{cardId}/checklists{title} → 201 {data} + Location`.
A foreign/missing `cardId` rolls back to 404 (no oracle, never 403);
garbage id → 400 `invalid-path` via `ValidPath`; blank/overlong titles →
400 `errors[]` via the DTO.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/cards/{id} → 200 {data:CardDetail}` (checklists{items},
labels, `checklist_progress` only when the card owns checklists).
Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400
`invalid-path` via `ValidPath`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/cards/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body). The position
gap closes with a set-based range `UPDATE` in the SAME tx. Foreign/missing
id → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/cards/{id} → 200 {data:CardDetail}` (scalars +
move/reorder, T24b): `title`/`description`/`due_date` patch as in T24a
(explicit `null` clears; empty `{}` is a no-op 200), while `column_id`
and/or `position` trigger a set-based move in the SAME tx — same-column =
one range shift + point update, cross-column = close-gap + open-gap +
point update. Requested positions clamp ([0, N-1] same-column, [0, M]
cross-column, missing cross-column position appends `M = max+1`) and the
CLAMPED value is written. Columns lock ascending (`min` first) via
`SELECT … FOR UPDATE`; the moving spot re-reads under `FOR UPDATE` so a
same-card race restarts the tx instead of writing unlocked. A
foreign/missing `column_id` rolls back to 404 (no oracle, never 403).
The response re-reads the stored row (never echoes).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/cards/{id}/labels{label_id} → 200 {data:CardDetail}`
(deprecated alias, kept one release; legacy camelCase `{labelId}` also
accepted via the DTO serde alias). Missing key → 400 `validation-error`
with `errors[]`; `0`/negative → 400 via the DTO range rule; ownership and
idempotency match [`attach_card_label`].

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/cards/{id}/labels/{label_id} → 200 {data:CardDetail}`
(idempotent: double attach keeps one link row). Foreign/missing card or
label → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/cards/{id}/labels/{label_id} → 204` (hard detach, empty
body). Unassigned (stale or never-attached) link → 404 (not 409);
foreign/missing card or label → 404 (no oracle, never 403 — ownership is
proven before the link check); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

404.description: Card, label, or assignment not found

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/checklist-items/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body).
Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400
`invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/checklist-items/{id}{text?,is_completed?} → 200 {data}`. An
empty `{}` body is a no-op 200. The response re-reads the stored row (never
echoes). Foreign/missing id → 404, never 403.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/checklists/{id} → 200 {data}` (items embedded `position
ASC`). Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400
`invalid-path` via `ValidPath`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/checklists/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body). Items
cascade via the DB `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK. Foreign/missing id → 404 (no
oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/checklists/{id}{title?} → 200 {data}`. An empty `{}` body
is a no-op 200. The response re-reads the stored row (never echoes).
Foreign/missing id → 404, never 403.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/checklists/{id}/items{text,position?} → 201 {data} +
Location`. An absent `position` appends at `MAX(position) + 1` taken under
`SELECT … FOR UPDATE` in the create tx; an explicit `position` writes
verbatim. A foreign/missing checklist id rolls back to 404 (no oracle,
never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path` via `ValidPath`; blank/overlong
text or negative `position` → 400 `errors[]` via the DTO (floats never reach
garde — serde rejects them first as `invalid-json`).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/columns/{colId}/cards?page&limit → 200 Page<CardSummary>`
(`position ASC`; never selects TEXT — no `description` key, only the
`has_description` flag; `checklist_progress` only when the card owns
checklists). Foreign/missing column → 404 (no oracle, never 403).

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/columns/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body). Cards
cascade via `ON DELETE CASCADE` FKs and the position gap closes with a
set-based range `UPDATE` in the SAME tx. Foreign/missing id → 404 (no
oracle, never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/columns/{id}{name?,sort_order?} → 200 {data}` (present
names validate like create; present `sort_order` rewrites card positions
by `created_at` via one set-based `UPDATE ... CASE` in the same tx —
never N saves). The column is pre-read for ownership (foreign/missing id
→ 404, never 403); absent keys are a no-op 200. The response re-reads the
stored row (never echoes).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/columns/{id}/move-cards{target_column_id} → 200
{data: {moved_count}}` (moves every card out of the source column,
appended at the target's `MAX(position)+1` in ONE tx; the source select
is `ORDER BY position ASC` so the target mirrors source order). Same-id
and cross-board targets are state errors → 400 `errors[]`; an empty
source is a success (`{moved_count: 0}`), never an error.
Foreign/missing source or target id → 404 (no oracle, never 403);
garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`; bad body → 400 via `ValidJson`.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/labels?page&limit → 200 Page<Label>` (`id ASC`). When the
user owns zero rows, the six prod defaults are lazy-seeded first via
[`ensure_default_labels`] (single multi-row `INSERT IGNORE` — a
concurrent seed race is a no-op, and a `409` from the helper is swallowed
so the list still returns 200).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/labels{name,color} → 201 {data} + Location`.
The name is trimmed before storage (`"  Side  "` stores `"Side"`, so
padded dups collide → 409 like exact and case-variant ones).
Blank/overlong/missing → 400 `errors[]` via the DTO; bad color → 400;
per-user dup (incl. case-variant under `utf8mb4_unicode_ci`) → 409 via
the shared 1062 arm.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/labels/{id} → 204` (no body). `card_labels` rows cascade
via `ON DELETE CASCADE`. Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle).

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/labels/{id}{name?,color?} → 200 {data}`. Empty-body patch
is a no-op 200 (row untouched); same-name patch stays 200; rename onto
another owned name (incl. case-variant) → 409; foreign id → 404.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/notes?search&type&tag_id&board_id&page&limit → 200
Page<NoteSummary>` (`updated_at DESC`; never selects TEXT — no `content`
key, only the summary shape). `type` is derived from which FK is set
(there is no column). Garbage `tag_id`/`board_id` never reach garde — axum
rejects them as 400 `invalid-query` first; a bad `type` enum and range
violations 400 with `errors[]`. Two-step IDs-then-enrich under one shared
`WHERE` builder (count via `COUNT(DISTINCT n.id)`, never `COUNT(*)` over
the tags join).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
Title substring filter (unconstrained by the catalogue; `%`/`_`/`\`
escaping is T27 store logic).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Note type filter on the wire (`?type=`): the Rust name avoids the
`r#type` raw identifier because garde 0.22 renders Rust idents into
`errors[]` paths (its `rename` attribute is parsed but ignored), so
`r#type` would leak a Rust-ism to clients.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description:
Tag filter (`>= 1`); garbage never reaches garde — axum rejects it
as 400 `invalid-query` first.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/notes{title,content,board_id?|project_id?|card_id?,tag_ids?}
→ 201 {data} + Location`. At most one FK may be set (multiple → 400; none
= `general`); linked targets must belong to the caller and every tag must
exist + belong to the caller (missing/foreign → 404, never 403 — create
aligns with update per `20-api-contract.md` notes). `tag_ids` are deduped
before linking.

404.description: Linked target or tag not found

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/notes/{id} → 200 {data}` (explicit `content` select — the
only path that reads TEXT). Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle, never
403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path` via `ValidPath`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/notes/{id} → 204` (hard delete, empty body). Tag links fan
out via `ON DELETE CASCADE` FKs. Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle,
never 403); garbage id → 400 `invalid-path`.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/notes/{id} → 200 {data}` (every field optional; explicit
`null` on an FK detaches, `tag_ids` present replaces the link set). The
merged FK set keeps the at-most-one rule (a merge leaving two links → 400
before any write); newly set links and tags are ownership-checked like
create (foreign/missing → 404). Empty `{}` is a no-op 200. The response
re-reads the stored rows (never echoes).

404.description: Note, linked target, or tag not found

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/projects?page&limit&q&sort&order → 200 Page<Project>`
(`board_count` real via a single `LEFT JOIN ... GROUP BY`; the count
query reuses the same `WHERE` without the join — exactly 2 statements
for any P, never N+1).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Name substring filter (`LIKE %q%` with `%`/`_`/`\` escaped in Rust +
`push_bind` only — never interpolated).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/projects{name} → 201 {data} + Location`.
Empty/blank/overlong names → 400 `errors[]` via the DTO.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id} → 204` (no body). Boards cascade in-tx
(explicit delete — the DB FK would `SET NULL`); foreign id → 404.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/tags?page&limit → 200 Page<Tag>` (`id ASC`). Tags have no
lazy seed (unlike labels): a fresh user lists `total == 0`.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/tags{name,color?} → 201 {data} + Location`.
The name is trimmed before storage (`"  Side  "` stores `"Side"`, so
padded dups collide → 409 like exact and case-variant ones). An omitted
color defaults to teal server-side (never echoed as missing).
Blank/overlong/missing → 400 `errors[]` via the DTO; overlong color →
400; per-user dup (incl. case-variant under `utf8mb4_unicode_ci`) → 409
via the local write-error map.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/tags/{id} → 204` (no body). `note_tags` rows cascade
via `ON DELETE CASCADE`. Foreign/missing id → 404 (no oracle).

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/tags/{id}{name?,color?} → 200 {data}`. Empty-body patch
is a no-op 200 (row untouched); same-name patch stays 200; rename onto
another owned name (incl. case-variant) → 409; foreign id → 404.

get.summary: Liveness probe: stable shape `{status:"ok"}`, no DB touch, no auth.

Readiness probe: `SELECT 1` through the pool. `200 {status:"ok",db:"up"}`
when MySQL answers, `503` problem+json otherwise — ANY pool error maps to
`503` (a wrong password is "not ready", not a 500). Fixed strings only:
driver errors can name users/hosts, so neither the error nor the URL is
interpolated into the body or the logs.

AttachLabelInput.description:
`POST /api/v1/cards/{id}/labels` deprecated alias body (T24c): snake_case
`{label_id}` with legacy camelCase `{labelId}` accepted for one release
(serde alias — both names decode into the same field). Missing → the
handler 400s `validation-error` with `errors[]` on `label_id`; `0` or
negative → 400 via the range rule (same `>= 1` shape as move `column_id`).

BoardDetailBody.description:
Success envelope for create/detail (`201 {data} + Location`, `200
{data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per `20-api-contract.md`).

BoardDetailResponse.description:
Wire board detail: the board plus its nested unpaginated `columns[]`
(`position ASC`). Carries no `description`/`content` keys (boards have
neither column); timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings (same fixed
shape as projects — `NaiveDateTime` has no utoipa `ToSchema` impl with
the `chrono` feature off, so the store formats once here instead of
leaking the representation into every handler).

BoardListResponse.description:
Wire board list item: the flat board shape (mirrors the Nest
`findAll`/`findArchived` mapping — no nested `columns[]`, no
`description`/`content` keys). Timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings
(same fixed shape as detail — `NaiveDateTime` has no utoipa `ToSchema`
impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store formats once instead of
leaking the representation into every handler).

CardBody.description:
Success envelope for create/detail/update (`201 {data} + Location`,
`200 {data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per
`20-api-contract.md`).

CardDetailResponse.description:
Wire card detail: scalars (TEXT selected here — never in lists) + label
refs + nested checklists{items} + optional progress rollup (present only
when the card owns ≥ 1 checklist, mirroring Nest `toCardResponse`).

oneOf.description: Checklist rollup (`None` = the card owns no checklist).

checklists.description: Nested checklists (`id` order) with items (`position ASC`).

description.description: Card description (`null` when unset — emitted, never omitted).

due_date.description:
`due_date` as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` (`null` when unset —
emitted, never omitted).

CardLabelRef.description: One label ref inside a card summary (`{id,name,color}`).

CardSummary.description:
Wire card summary: scalars + label refs + optional progress. Carries no
`description` key (TEXT is never selected); `due_date` renders as an
ISO-8601 string or `null`.

oneOf.description: Checklist rollup (`None` = the card owns no checklist).

has_description.description: Whether the card has a non-blank description (SQL `CASE`, never TEXT).

ChecklistBody.description:
Success envelope for create/detail/update (`201 {data} + Location`,
`200 {data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per
`20-api-contract.md`).

ChecklistItemBody.description:
Success envelope for item create/update (`201 {data} + Location`,
`200 {data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per
`20-api-contract.md`).

ChecklistItemResponse.description: One checklist item on the wire (T26a nests; T26b owns the item routes).

ChecklistListBody.description:
Success envelope for the card-scoped list (`200 {data[]}`, small-N
unpaginated per `21 §checklists` — added route).

ChecklistProgress.description: Checklist rollup attached only when the card owns ≥ 1 checklist.

ChecklistResponse.description: One checklist on the wire, with items (`position ASC`).

ColumnBody.description:
Success envelope for create/update (`201 {data} + Location`, `200
{data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per `20-api-contract.md`).

ColumnListBody.description:
Success envelope for the nested list (`200 {data[]}`, unpaginated —
paginating board columns would break board rendering).

ColumnResponse.description:
Wire column: scalars + nested card summaries (`position ASC`, never
`description` TEXT — see [`crate::common::card_summary`]).

position.description: Zero-based position (`position ASC` order on the wire).

ColumnSummary.description:
One nested column in a board detail body (`id`, `name`, `position` only —
never cards; the column-cards list lives under `GET /columns/:col/cards`).

position.description: Zero-based position (`position ASC` order on the wire).

name.description: Board name: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.

position.description: Explicit position (insert-with-open-gap; clamped in store, never 400).

title.description: Card title: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.
Checklist title: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.

text.description: Item text: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.

CreateColumnInput.description:
`POST /api/v1/boards/{boardId}/columns` body (T23a handler): absent name
defaults to `New Column` in the store.

name.description: Column name (`<= 255` chars); present means non-blank.
Label name: 1..=50 chars, non-blank after trim.

content.description:
Note content: 1..=65_535 chars (empty → 400, Nest `IsNotEmpty`
parity; whitespace-only stays allowed — content is outside the
catalogue's trim list).

title.description: Note title: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.

name.description: Project name: non-blank after trim, `<= 255` chars.

color.description: Tag color, free-form `<= 20` chars (absent → teal in store).

name.description: Tag name: non-blank after trim, `<= 50` chars.

FieldError.description: One field-level failure inside the problem `errors[]` extension.

LabelBody.description:
Success envelope for create/update (`201 {data} + Location`, `200 {data}`;
no `message` key — dropped everywhere per `20-api-contract.md`).

LabelResponse.description:
Wire label item: timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings (`NaiveDateTime`
has no utoipa `ToSchema` impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store
formats once here instead of leaking the representation into handlers).

color.description: Label color (one of the 6 enum values).

LoginInput.description: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` body (T11 handler): non-empty + byte cap only.

LoginResponse.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/login → 200` body (same shape as register, no
`message` envelope key — dropped per `20-api-contract.md`).

MeResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/auth/me → 200` body (fresh row values — the handler
re-looks-up the user; never the stale session payload).

MoveCardsData.description:
`POST /api/v1/columns/{id}/move-cards` success envelope (T23c handler):
`200 {data: {moved_count}}` (no `message` key — dropped everywhere per
`20-api-contract.md`; `movedCount→moved_count` per `21 §columns`).

moved_count.description:
Number of cards moved into the target column (`0` when the source is
empty — an empty source is a success, never an error).

NoteBody.description:
Success envelope for create/detail/update (`201 {data} + Location`,
`200 {data}`; no `message` key — dropped everywhere per
`20-api-contract.md`).

NoteDetailResponse.description:
Wire note detail: the summary shape plus `content` (explicitly selected —
the source entity marks it `select:false`, so only this path reads it).

content.description: Note content (`null` when absent — emitted, never omitted).

Page_BoardListResponse.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire board list item: the flat board shape (mirrors the Nest
`findAll`/`findArchived` mapping — no nested `columns[]`, no
`description`/`content` keys). Timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings
(same fixed shape as detail — `NaiveDateTime` has no utoipa `ToSchema`
impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store formats once instead of
leaking the representation into every handler).

Page_CardSummary.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire card summary: scalars + label refs + optional progress. Carries no
`description` key (TEXT is never selected); `due_date` renders as an
ISO-8601 string or `null`.

oneOf.description: Checklist rollup (`None` = the card owns no checklist).

has_description.description: Whether the card has a non-blank description (SQL `CASE`, never TEXT).

Page_LabelResponse.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire label item: timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings (`NaiveDateTime`
has no utoipa `ToSchema` impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store
formats once here instead of leaking the representation into handlers).

color.description: Label color (one of the 6 enum values).

Page_NoteSummaryResponse.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire note summary: the list shape (TEXT-free — no `content` key, mirroring
the cards-list `description` rule; detail `GET /:id` only selects it).
`type` is NOT a field (there is no column): clients derive it from which
FK is set, same as the Nest `getNoteType` helper.

Page_ProjectResponse.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire project item: `board_count` is real (single `LEFT JOIN ... GROUP BY`
aggregation — the old Nest `boardCount: 0` stub is dropped) and
timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings (`NaiveDateTime` has no utoipa
`ToSchema` impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store formats once
here instead of leaking the representation into every handler).

board_count.description: Boards linked to this project (user-scoped join, never N+1).

Page_TagResponse.description:
Paginated list envelope. `total` is the full count for the applied
filters, not the length of this page.

items.description:
Wire tag item: timestamps render as UTC ISO-8601 strings (`NaiveDateTime`
has no utoipa `ToSchema` impl with the `chrono` feature off, so the store
formats once here instead of leaking the representation into handlers).
Tags carry `created_at` ONLY — no `updated_at` by design (see
`30-db-schema.md`; tags are rename-light).

color.description: Tag color (free-form, defaults to teal server-side).

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 9457 body. `status` duplicates the HTTP status (kept for the frontend
`ApiError` which preserves it); `errors` is omitted when empty.

detail.description: Request-specific detail. Never carries driver/SQL/secret text.

status.description: HTTP status code (mirrors the response status).

ProjectBody.description:
Success envelope for create/update (`201 {data} + Location`, `200 {data}`;
no `message` key — dropped everywhere per `20-api-contract.md`).

ProjectRef.description:
Owning-project ref embedded in a board detail body (`{id,name} | null`,
mirroring the Nest `BoardResponse.project` shape).

board_count.description: Boards linked to this project (user-scoped join, never N+1).

ReadyResponse.description:
Readiness response body `{status:"ok",db:"up"}` (`503` problem+json when
the database is unreachable).

password.description: New password: strength + byte cap (never bare garde `length`).

TagBody.description:
Success envelope for create/update (`201 {data} + Location`, `200 {data}`;
no `message` key — dropped everywhere per `20-api-contract.md`).

TagRef.description: One tag link inside a note body (`id` order).

Tags carry `created_at` ONLY — no `updated_at` by design (see

color.description: Tag color (free-form, defaults to teal server-side).

UpdateBoardInput.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/boards/{id}` body (T22 handler): every field optional;
present values validate the same rules as create. `project_id` is a
double `Option` so explicit `null` (detach) stays observable: missing →
`None` (untouched), `null` → `Some(None)` (detach), int →
`Some(Some(..))` (relink, ownership-checked to 404).

is_archived.description: Archive flag flip (idempotent archive/restore; bool needs no rule).

name.description: Board name: present means non-blank, `<= 255` chars.

UpdateCardInput.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/cards/{id}` body (T24a scalars-only handler; T24b adds
move semantics for `column_id`/`position`).

column_id.description:
Target column id for cross-column moves (`>= 1`; T24b owns it —
the T24a handler ignores it).

position.description:
Target position (clamped in store, never 400; T24b owns it — the T24a
handler ignores it).

title.description: Card title: present means non-blank, `<= 255` chars.
Checklist title: present means non-blank, `<= 255` chars.

text.description: Item text: present means non-blank, `<= 255` chars.

UpdateColumnInput.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/columns/{id}` body (T23a rename + T23b sort): either key
may appear (both are applied, rename first). Absent keys leave that
aspect untouched, so `{}` stays a no-op 200.

name.description: Column name (`<= 255` chars); present means non-blank.

sort_order.description:
Card sort direction (`asc` | `desc`); rewrites card positions by
`created_at` via one set-based `UPDATE ... CASE`.

name.description: Label name: present means 1..=50 chars and non-blank.

tag_ids.description: Linked tag ids (each `>= 1`); present replaces the link set.

title.description: Note title: present means non-blank, `<= 255` chars.

name.description: Tag name: present means non-blank, `<= 50` chars.

UserData.description:
Authenticated user shape shared by register/login/me responses:
`{data:{id,email,role}}` (no `message` envelope key — dropped per `20`).

role.description: `user` on register (admin only via the T12 CLI).
